messages.author: 3fafb6e3d7e91f4a
messages.subject: MATLABStan and cores
parts:
So "cores" does not seem to be among the options for Stan in MATLAB,
> help stan
 does not list this option, which is available in RStan,
    is this something un-availabe for a deep under-the-hood  reason in MATLAB
or will it be enabled ?

  Similarly, "-O=3"  optimization in "make" does not seem to be an option in MATLAB.

thank you
  -Leon

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Re: MATLABStan and cores
parts:
Hi,

MatlabStan is developed by Brian Lau, It seems that Brian is not reading this forum and there doesn't seem to be so many Matlab users here, so it's better to
 1) check the MatlabStan wiki https://github.com/brian-lau/MatlabStan/wiki
 2) open an issue in github https://github.com/brian-lau/MatlabStan/

Since MatlabStan is calling CmdStan, all the options available for CmdStan could be added to MatlabStan interface, too.

Aki
